# `ExampleFailed`

`Rasuvaeff\PropertyTesting\Runner\ExampleFailed`

**Class** — **Package:** [property-testing-core](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core) — [Source](https://github.com/rasuvaeff/property-testing-core/blob/master/src/Runner/ExampleFailed.php#L15) — **Version:** working tree

minimal, so the input is reported verbatim, without shrinking.
